description: Noise generator with a continuously variable spectrum slope, covering white, pink, red, blue and violet noise and everything between them

params.text: Sets the slope of the noise spectrum, -8dB per octave fully counter-clockwise to 8dB per octave fully clockwise, with the display below showing the spectrum
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the input jack before it is added to the slope knob

inputs.text: Sets the slope through the trim knob beside it

outputs.text: The noise; its slope is held flat below 40Hz and above 6000Hz, which keeps the extremes from running away
